# t_funcs.exp_decay { #clerq.t_funcs.exp_decay }

```python
t_funcs.exp_decay(index)
```

Return a decaying-exponential pulse time function.

Zero before ``on``, then ``ampl * exp(-(t - on) / tau)``, the envelope of
a photon emitted by a decaying source.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                          |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}``, ``on_{index}`` and |
|        | TFunc  | ``tau_{index}`` (the 1/e time of the amplitude) from args.           |
